note: T2.3 kernel case: the half-profile of a UG-32 torispherical head (ID 1000, t 10, SF 30; knuckle and crown drawn with sketch.arc.center_point, the crown ending on the axis) revolved 360° about Z. Metal volume should be 12,224,761 mm³; kernel::measure reports 172,765,065 because one sector's spherical crown face covers the wrong part of its sphere (the face count is right). Drawing the same arcs with sketch.arc.three_point fails on other presets (ASME F&D, Klöpper, 80:10). Fallback in triya-vessel::emit: every circular arc is emitted as an exact conic (sketch.conic, apex at the tangent intersection, rho = w/(1+w), w = cos(θ/2)); test torispherical_heads_match_analytic_volume covers all presets.
